description: Lab devices by the ro.product.model a capture reads, with the SoC that model ships with. Publication refuses a session whose SoC contradicts its model's entry and leaves a row from an unlisted model unverified (docs/RUN-CONDITIONS.md, Publication policy v1). SoC values compare case-insensitively. Add a device only from a host getprop record of that phone. chipName is the SoC's marketing name for that phone, shown on the board (rows carry it as chipName); soc stays the code the policy checks. Sources: docs/WEBSITE-HANDOFF.md, Chip names.
